column3: Saori Route ・ Plan Execution Report
If you're willing to go that far, shall I listen to what you have to say?
Though I'm warning you, I shan't forgive any joking around.
I-I won't.
She's become serious...
Should I try to lighten the mood a bit?
No, I finally managed to get focused, I shouldn't say anything unnecessary.
I have no reason to joke around when my friend is having troubles.
Haha, the way you face me and say that, I'm feeling awkward!
So, what's the plan?
You may indeed be unable to cancel the engagement.
But, how about the other side?
Which means...?
I remembered about those guys I heard at the station.
When I heard them, at first I was thinking...
What are they saying in front of Saori!
But now that I think about it, it may have been a sign from God.
Your fiance is a normal!
Your fiance is matching for a normal!
And right now, Saori isn't behaving like one!
You're mismatched for your fiance!
Err... Kyousuke-shi...
...Aren't you mistaken...?
A-Am I...?
Maybe I failed to express my point with how I said it...
Hm... Seems like the words I picked weren't appropriate.
Then how about this?
You are an otaku through and through. Make your fiance understand that.
He doesn't understand otaku, so he won't get half of what you say.
If you do that, isn't there a chance that in light of it, your fiance will cancel the engagement on his side?
Hm...
I see. Kyousuke-shi's quite the tactician.
But I wonder if it'd go well...
I understand how you feel, should this fail, you would lose heart indeed.
But, even if I myself failed twice, third time was the charm.
You failed?
The fist time was the phone call, the second time was the chat.
And on the third time, by taking Kuroneko's place, I managed to reach my goal at last.
Ah...
Seems like the smart Saori caught on.
To hear what was the cause of her awkwardness, I had to try three times.
I even went through Kirino's prying without flinching.
I understand.
I feel a bit awkward about acting in order to be disliked...
But if I want to stay who I am, I'll stick with it.
Good, well said Saori!
Rejoiced at Saori's words, I patted her head just like I used to do with Kirino.
Even though Saori's bigger than I am.
K-Kyousuke-shi!?
Oh! Sorry! That was bad of me.
No... It just surprised me a little...
I-It wasn't bad... I guess?
*gulp* W-What's going on...
The way she says it...
Kinda... makes my heart race...
Your compatibility is bad; it's impossible for you to stay together.
Your fiance may have said that he understands otaku.
But he doesn't condone them, right?
Ughhh... Indeed... I can't argue with that...
